reviews.text:
Dr. Catona was absolutely wonderful! She was incredibly knowledgeable, kind, patient, and genuinely caring. My boxer was very distressed because her little tail was hurting, and she is also scared of getting up on the examination table. Dr. Catona didn’t hesitate to crouch down on the floor to examine her and address the problem where she felt most comfortable. I truly appreciated her gentle approach, compassion, and willingness to go the extra mile to help my girl.

The veterinary technician who assisted us was also wonderful, gentle, and very helpful. Unfortunately, I didn’t catch her name, but I really appreciated her kindness and care as well.

It was clear that the entire team genuinely cared about making my dog feel safe and comfortable. I’m so grateful for such a positive experience and highly recommend Dr. Catona and the team to anyone looking for knowledgeable, compassionate veterinary care!

I’ve also had wonderful experiences during my previous visits. Everyone on the team, ALL the veterinary technicians, like Alex, has been so kind, caring, and clearly passionate about what they do. I also have a great deal of appreciation for Dr. Bell. It’s wonderful to find a veterinary practice where you feel that both you and your pets are genuinely cared for. Thank you all for everything you do! ❤️

The staff are all kind and love the animals. The prices are so good for people who cannot afford to get shots at the vet. I had my dog neutered and shipped and it was a fraction of the cost that my vet that's in a corporate situation would have charged. They even have flea and tick medication if you need it

Very, very professional staff and passionate about pets! I drove an hour for service. Every minute of travel was worth it....5 🌟 service. Transferring both of my pups care to this location moving forward....

Had an appointment to have my dog spayed. Was told to arrive by 8am. Arrived early and waited until 10 after 8 for a petsmart employee to come out and say nobody would be arriving until 930! Like, what? Unacceptable. I, along with many others, drove from over an hour away. So frustrating and extremely unprofessional.

I cant express in text just how incredible this place is!!! I have been through hell and back getting over charged at places like PASE and local Philly animal hospitals making it impossibe to afford vet care! Emancipet was THE EXACT OPPOSITE! Our dog Moses is a huge Old English Sheepdog and his Neuter surgery went beautifully. They were so kind, so attentive, genuinely cared about our fur baby, and even recognized him when we returned. Dr C and her staff are actual angels on earth doing Gods work. They charged me $7 for a script another vet wanted $200, They charged me $125 for a surgery another Animal Hosp wanted $700 and they were incredibly professional and even text you with updates etc. They let me walk him back bc he was scared, they calmed him etc. They honestly couldnt have been kinder. I literally cried when i got the bill (happy tears) because this was the first time in years someone tried to make my life easier......THANK YOU FOR MAKING VET CARE AVAILABLE FOR ALL!!! They are doing Gods work here. And my sons recovery is going so well, we decided to have our other two rescue dogs spay there in 2 weeks. This was a big decision bc they are two overbred puppy mill mamma rescues and I feel confident in their surgical care at this clinic. Be sure to donate and bring those workers their flowers!!!!!! WE LOVE YOU!!!!!
One of the best pet clinics with affordable prices and excellent services.
Enjoyable experience, pick up and drop off was smooth and the technicians were friendly and helpful.
Great place!

Emacipet is the miracle i was waiting for. My vet was gonna charge me $950 for the Neturing procedure....  and... and.... I paid only $89 for that at @emancipet. All medical and administrative staff were very friendly and nice. Thank you
Staff is amazing. I trust them with my pets.

I was very disappointed with my experience at this veterinary clinic. The staff seemed more focused on getting people in and out than on providing reassurance or answering questions. As a concerned pet owner, I had several questions about my dog’s spay surgery and aftercare, but I felt as though my questions were an inconvenience. The gentleman with dreadlocks/braids at the pickup counter was also very difficult to understand because he spoke very quietly and mumbled. I don’t fault him personally, but management should ensure someone is available who can communicate clearly, especially when giving important post-surgical instructions. Overall, the experience felt like a production line—bring the dogs in, perform the procedure, and get them back out—with very little personal attention. I understand this is a low-cost facility, but I don’t believe that should mean sacrificing customer service. Had I known the experience would feel this rushed and impersonal, I would have gladly spent the extra money to have my regular vet perform the procedure.
I truly hope management actually reads this review and moving forward makes the whole experience a little more comfortable for the pet and owners

This clinic was outstanding! Dr. Jonathan Ball was extremely knowledgeable and gentle, vet technicians were wonderful as well. I was able to get my pet up to date with his shots as well as acquire flea medicine for a VERY low cost. Over half the price of my last vet without sacrificing anything at all. 5 stars ❤️
Good and affordable

I am an Adam’s Avenue regular (well I was) until last Saturday. There was such a long line 1/2 hour prior to opening so I decided to check out the Roosevelt Blvd. location. I am so glad I did. This one is inside PetSmart and SMART indeed!!! The wait time from check in until we got seen, was minimal. Valerie was our tech and she was AMAZING!! She was so gentle with my lil one and just genuinely nice. The staff were all quite pleasant and then the lovely Dr. Lee came in with her beautiful smile and she did a thorough exam of Dolce, prior to giving him his vaccine. I love that they give the 3 years rabies vaccine. She was so quick, Dolce didn’t feel a thing. I was happy I didn’t have to spend all morning waiting and the extra drive was worth it with the great service provided. Adam’s Ave. is great too but usually crowded early mornings. Being inside a PetSmart allowed me to get some well-needed pet supplies as well. I was so excited to go shop, I forgot I had to pay for the pet visit and the at the desk was so nice about it when she found me in the aisle. Even the PetSmart employees were quite nice.

We had a great experience at Emancipet when our puppy, Milo, was neutered. The staff was so kind, friendly, and caring from start to finish. They made us feel comfortable leaving him and answered all of our questions.

We dropped Milo off at 8:00 AM, and he was ready to be picked up by 2:00 PM. Everything was quick, organized, and went really smoothly. We’re so thankful for the great care they gave him.

I would definitely recommend Emancipet to anyone looking for affordable, compassionate care for their pet!

I really love this Emancipet located in Petsmart...the convenience of having vet/grooming services within a pet supply store is ingenious. The staff are all super nice and you can tell they love what they do. This puts me at ease and I know they are caring for my pup well. Great place!

Walki-in with minimal waiting time (went there around 10 am), polite, professional staff. Check up, vaccination, testing and chip placement were at least twice cheaper than they cost at regular vet clinic.
Had my puppy spayed here. Staff were amazing.
Acceptable animal care & fair price
Vets are great. They get down on the ground and play with my dogs and cats.
Nice staff and great value especially if you have multiple pets.
I highly recommend it!

Emancipet gave me back my dog covered in feces. They called us urgently because he was pooping a lot. Instead of cleaning him up they called us saying we need to pick him up asap. Feces all in his nails and on his legs. I understand anesthesia has side effects but I would hope they are equipped enough to deal with it. Service was sub par. No one wanted to give any helpful information. We appreciate the one man who seemed like he cared for my dog but other than that rude personalities all around.
Awesome Vet Dr. and Technician. They did a great job for my 100 lb puppy Newfoundland.
The best service ever
Very nice experience the staff was friendly and helpful and the store was very clean
Fantastic

I will never use Emancipet again. I took my dog to the Roosevelt Blvd location in Philadelphia, PA yesterday. I was given three medications for my dog. After I read the papers and gave him the medication I noticed one of the bottles was not prescribed to me but it was prescribed to another patient, it was the same medicine however. I then called the emergency contact number where the doctor said my dog will be okay he will just be extremely tired for 8-12 hours and that tomorrow (Monday) I can stop by the Adams Avenue location to swap out and get the correct medication.

My concern is this, although I received double medication (same dosage) this is an extreme lack of responsibly on the employees who filled my dogs prescriptions and switched them up with another dogs prescriptions.  These types of situations are avoidable but when there is neglect like this it is how animals end up in the hospital.

Emancipet on Roosevelt Blvd is amazing. Very professional, affordable, and efficient. I’ve used them for spay/neuter, vaccines, and wellness visits, and the care has always been excellent. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality vet care without high prices.
Had our kitten spayed and all her shots and the prices are amazing but the Staff is excellent they're very loving and caring with your pets !!
I like it, it's very affordable.

I want to thank Dr. Johnathan and the tech Angie for helping me with my new puppy and letting me express myself on the the loss of my husband and how my son bought me an emotional support dog chewy you guys are amazing and very caring.

Took all of our pets here. 3 cat's and 2 dogs. The got neutered, spayed, shots and chipped. They help families who are extremely low income with those services at certain moments throughout the year. The whole place was extremely helpful, kind and will answer all of your questions. Places like this are such a important place for families to be able to go to. Extremely grateful for them.
The clinic was very crowded but the staff navigated the crowd very well

Low cost pet clinic inside the Petsmart. Everyone was really friendly, got my questions answered. Prices for annual wellness are great. Did routine vaccines, ear cleaning, gland expression, heartworm test, and got yearly preventatives, it was about $350 total (about $250 of the cost was the flea, tick, and heartworm preventatives), which is a deal in the pet world. They don't do nail trims at this location because they have the grooming service on site so you would have to book a pet grooming appointment if you want that.

What a great experience! Online appointment booking was a breeze. Pricing is more than fair. Everyone was super nice, from the front-desk girl, to the tech Angie, and Dr Catona. They were super great with both my girls during the appointment.

Every step, from check-in to end, was explained in detail.

Highly recommend this place!

I had my Rottie Spayed here and the service was awesome and things went well. Unfortunately, my girl ended up with kennel cough. I have 3 Rotties and all of them are sick with it now. Being treated by our veterinarian now. Poor things. Please be careful here.

Took my dog and cat here. They both got fixed and their shots. It was easy to make an appointment. The staff were friendly and informative. Everything went great with their procedures. The prices are very reasonable and make it affordable to get pets medical care.
Got our puppy vaccinated and they were so very nice and welcoming and the puppy took the shots like no problem because they were so good at their job! Great place!

Staff is friendly, professional, well organized, and efficient. The place is very clean.

I needed to get my cat neutered ASAP.  I only had to wait a week for an appointment and could easily schedule the appointment online.

Made reservation for cat spay. Got text the day before saying to arrive by 8am. Arrived and petsmart ppl said they pushed it back to ten am and wonder why they didn’t send text. Now it’s 8:30am a blackboard was out saying it’s canceled. I don’t think “we apologize” means anything. A heads-up the day before would have been more helpful.

The place is terrible, dirty, and full of fleas, we had our cat spayed and brought them clean animal, at pick up were told that she had fleas and had to be treated for it. When brought animal home she certainly had them after this clinic visit. Please thank twice before taking your animal there.

These people were so lovely that I won't even take a star away just because of the horrible PetSmart they are located inside of. It would be nice if it was noted somewhere that they were actually located inside of the PetSmart. (Maybe they did and I missed it.)

Wonderful job on my boy. Everyone was caring and attentive from start to finish and really cared. Alex was especially kind and helpful. He even helped me bring my boy out to my truck at the end. He was also very patient and empathetic to my complaints about the location itself. Prices were outstanding also.

The PetSmart itself (outside) was filthy and the manager was blatantly inconsiderate. They would not allow me to use a restroom while there to pickup my pet after driving from NJ with personal needs for feminine care. Even after having to be embarrassed to actually plead to use a restroom, even the store manager would not allow it. Apparently they turn away elderly and disabled patrons as well, according to another staff who has to deny people, due to policy, all the time. The store management is too lazy to have to delegate cleaning to keep a clean bathroom and simply be diligent to deny use to outside public. I was a paying customer. They need to fix this as well as stop being lazy and clean all of the urine and feces that are outside for God knows how long! Some of it is so old it's even dried up.

So watch your step on the way out of your car going inside. And make sure you use the bathroom at Target if you're closeby and have to go. They're the real MVP here. All in all, just due to the location issues, I would try the other location next time I'm booking an appointment.
Low cost per prevention. They are wonderful and doing a great service to the community.
They were very attentive and helpful. Explained everything. I recommend.

I took my Frenchie, Ellie, to Emancipet for her spay surgery, and I can’t say enough good things about our experience. This was my first time going through something like this because she is my first dog, and I was so nervous. I wanted to be absolutely sure that she was in the hands of a talented and caring team who would treat her like their own.

From start to finish, the staff at Emancipet exceeded every expectation. Everyone was so kind, patient, and professional. The booking process was simple and stress-free, and they were very open to answering all of my questions and addressing any concerns I had. On the day of her surgery, the check-in process was quick and organized, which really helped calm my nerves.

When I picked Ellie up, she was a little sleepy (as expected), but they had cleaned her up so beautifully—there wasn’t even a drop of blood. When I checked her incision at home, it looked amazing. The stitches were so clean and neat, and her recovery has been going so smoothly ever since.

I’m so grateful to the entire Emancipet team for taking such wonderful care of my girl and giving me peace of mind throughout the entire process. You can truly tell that everyone there cares deeply about the animals they treat. Thank you for everything, you’ve earned a forever client in us!
The most cost efficient Spay/Neuter and routine vaccinations.
Organized team. They handled my large and aggressive German Shepherd Dogs fine. Easy in and out. Clean and affordable

I could not be more grateful or happier with the level of care, service and last-minute life saving surgery my dog received here.

I found myself in a terrible position. My dog had become extremely ill overnight. In the morning she was diagnosed with Pyometra. Without pet insurance or access to a large credit line, the quotes other clinics gave me for emergency surgery were completely unaffordable.

I saw Emancipet while searching online for resources, called them and explained the urgent situation. They fit me in, SAME DAY (unheard of) with the most unbelievably charitable price possible. ($150) (I was being quoted over $6000+) Finding Emancipet was truly a miracle beyond comprehension.

I’m still in disbelief. Dr Lopez was phenomenal. The team was amazing. They worked with me to save her life, I am forever grateful. I will be donating to Petsmart Charities and Emancipet for the rest of my life. The nonprofit work they’re doing here is beyond touching, and the impact they made on my family and I is immeasurable. I almost lost my baby, but Emancipet allowed her to see another day.

Thank you eternally.
The cat was neutered, vaccinated, and given flea medication. The price was absolutely fantastic. The staff was caring and compassionate.
Excellent vets.  Definitely going back there
Excellent service and treatment. You can tell they love furry friends. Thank you so much!
Great service
He treats his patients very specially; my coconut is always treated with a lot of love and great care.
Very nice prices and staff are pleasant.
Very expensive and the service is just okay depending on who serves you, but the place is clean.

My puppy had an earache and the vet and the assistant was nice and empathetic to my puppy. 4 stars was because I called ahead of time to see when I could come in. They said come in anytime no appointments needed. Of course when I got there the staff was just going on an hour lunch. I'm still glad I went.
Great place to bring your pet for vaccinations and other things.
100% worthy of donations and trust for your pets vaccines or surgery.
Very professional, friendly vet workers. Happy with my kittens surgery and shots. Easy drop off and pickup.
An affordable alternative to a private vet or even the spca.
There are always a lot of people here, and that’s actually a good sign. I trust them with my cat.
Great people, great service, great medical care.
Low cost pet care. Expert staff.

We have taken our dogs here for annual shots as well as a spay for one dog.  All of our visits have been positive. The drs and staff are all very nice. There may be a slight wait, but it’s worth it for the price of the shots when compared to other Veterinarians.
Good price. Great staff.

I literally drove almost 2 hours on a Saturday to get my dog in for an emergency surgery and I would do it again! At first the phone call was not convincing that they care but arriving to the facility and know reps work from home made me understand why the phone call didn’t put me at ease. Dr Lopez was the one who performed the surgery and I just loved her from the moment she stepped in the room. The nurses and doctor were so comforting and literally put my heart at ease and made it known they will take care of my little Mia. They took the time to answer all my questions and give me the attention I needed and I thank them for that. My Mia had a life threatening bacterial infection that would cause her life and they took it very serious. Thank you so much!
Love this place for affordable checkups and vaccines. I am so glad they opened up a place so close. Do be mindful that the wait time can be more than 60 minutes on weekends.
First rate everything from the staff to the  prices. Everyone was kind and helpful, and you can't beat the prices. Wish I knew about with my other dogs
Good day, who can help me get my dog ​​operated on? She has a hernia and couldn't stand up today. How can you help me get her operated on because I'm not working? Thank you very much.
Simply, they are the best

We are forever grateful to Emancipet and Dr. Jonathan Ball for saving our dog Molly’s life. At 12 years old, she was diagnosed with pyometra, a life-threatening infection that required immediate, high-risk emergency surgery. Within just 12 hours of diagnosis, Emancipet stepped up and gave us hope when we felt like we were running out of time and options.

Dr. Ball’s compassion and calm presence reassured us during one of the scariest moments we’ve ever experienced. He treated Molly like she was his own and made us feel seen, heard, and supported every step of the way. Thanks to him and the incredible team at Emancipet, our sweet girl is now on the road to recovery.

Thank God we found this amazing clinic — we truly believe they were the answer to our prayers. Thank you, Dr. Ball, for giving Molly a second chance at life.
